symbols.name: fixed bilinear space
symbols.meaning: The fixed bilinear space that contains every label, with bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ denote the fixed bilinear space, with bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$, and let its dimension be $m$, the number of coordinates of a vector of $E$.

symbols.name: ambient dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of $E$, which counts the coordinates of a vector of $E$.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ denote the fixed bilinear space, with bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$, and let its dimension be $m$, the number of coordinates of a vector of $E$.

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A nondegenerate subspace of $E$ attached to a gate or terminal.
symbols.quote: A label is a nondegenerate subspace $U$ of $E$.

symbols.name: head label
symbols.meaning: The label at the head of an edge, whose tail label is $U$.
symbols.quote: On an edge, $U$ and $V$ are its tail and head labels.

symbols.name: label frame
symbols.meaning: The frame at a vertex whose label is $U$.
symbols.quote: A vertex whose label is $U$ has frame $C_U$, the operator that turns the logical array into the stored array there.

symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set on which triples are taken.
symbols.quote: Let $h$ be the size of a ground set, and let $J$ be the all-one $h\times h$ matrix.

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.meaning: The $h\times h$ matrix whose entries are all $1$.
symbols.quote: Let $h$ be the size of a ground set, and let $J$ be the all-one $h\times h$ matrix.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set.
symbols.quote: A triple $T$ is a three-element subset of the ground set, with indicator vector $t_T\in\mathbb{Q}^h$.

symbols.name: triple indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of a triple $T$ in $\mathbb{Q}^h$, with a one in each coordinate of an element of $T$ and zero elsewhere.
symbols.quote: A triple $T$ is a three-element subset of the ground set, with indicator vector $t_T\in\mathbb{Q}^h$.

symbols.name: other triple
symbols.meaning: Another triple of the ground set, compared with $T$ through the form.
symbols.quote: For another triple $S$, $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle = |S\cap T| - 1$, so triples sharing exactly one element give orthogonal lines.
